SELECT t.id, t.name, t.code, t.cover_url, t.summary, t.category_id, t.status, t.sort, t.publish_time, t.created_at, t.updated_at FROM topic t WHERE t.deleted = 0
AND t.status = 'PUBLISHED'
AND t.status = #{query.status}
AND t.category_id IN
#{categoryId}
AND t.name LIKE #{query.keywordPattern} ESCAPE '!'
ORDER BY t.sort ASC, t.publish_time DESC, t.id DESC

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM topic_content tc INNER JOIN content c ON c.id = tc.content_id AND c.deleted = 0 WHERE tc.topic_id = #{topicId} AND tc.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' AND c.content_type IN ('ARTICLE', 'VIDEO', 'QUESTION', 'WEEKLY', 'DOCUMENT')
